extracted.name: Bow pasta
ingredient_lines: Chicken marinated in chicken tikka spices, lemon juice half teaspoon salt black pepper and any spices you would like to add
instruction_lines: Now boil pasta to tender. Drain and set aside.
Now for béchamel sauce add flour in a pot fry it then add milk. Thicken it then add pinch of salt and bit of oregano leaves. Sauce is ready set aside.
Now fry the marinated chicken in air fryer or deep fry.
Now mix all these ingredients and serve 😀. Enjoy!
